Class Lobby

java.lang.Object
network.server.core.Lobby
public class Lobby extends Object
A pre-game gathering of PlayerEntrys waiting for the lobby to fill up. Not internally synchronized: LobbyManager is the sole owner and mutates it only on its single lobby thread, so all access is already serialised.
